Our Story

Where every plate tells
a story of Balasore.

Located near ADM Square in Manikhamb, Gopalgoan, Spicy Garden is known for authentic flavors, elegant ambiance, premium hospitality, and unforgettable dining experiences. From quiet family dinners to romantic evenings, every meal here is crafted with perfection — a kitchen that treats Odisha's love of good food as something worth honouring.
